name: system.restart_required
description: Reports whether a reboot or a service restart is needed after an update. Reads distro reboot marker files, the running kernel against the installed module trees, and processes that run a binary or library replaced on disk. Returns reboot_required, restart_required, the reasons found and whether the process scan was truncated. Reads only files below root and executes nothing.

root.description: Optional absolute directory that stands in for the root of the filesystem, for tests and chroots. Omitted reads the live system under /.
